questions.question: According to the 2017 standards, what percentage of adults aged 65 and older had hypertension?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('65 and older')].iloc[0]
result = float(row[2])

questions.question: Based on the 2017 standards, by how many percentage points did the age-adjusted hypertension prevalence for men exceed that for women?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
male_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Male'].iloc[0, 2])
female_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Female'].iloc[0, 2])
result = round(male_val - female_val, 1)

questions.question: Under the 2017 standards, was the age-adjusted prevalence of hypertension highest among Black adults compared to all other reported racial and ethnic groups?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
race_rows = df.iloc[7:11]
black_rate = float(race_rows[race_rows[0].str.strip() == 'Black only'].iloc[0, 2])
other_max = race_rows[race_rows[0].str.strip() != 'Black only'][2].astype(float).max()
result = 'yes' if black_rate > other_max else 'no'

questions.question: Among adults grouped by age bracket (20–44, 45–64, and 65 and older), which group had the lowest crude prevalence of hypertension under the 2007 standards?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
age_rows = df.iloc[20:23].copy()
age_rows[1] = pd.to_numeric(age_rows[1])
result = str(age_rows.sort_values(by=1).iloc[0, 0]).strip()

questions.question: What was the average crude hypertension prevalence across the three age groups (20–44, 45–64, and 65 and older) under the 2007 standards?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus2022_hypertension.xlsx', sheet_name='VI', header=None)
age_rows = df.iloc[20:23]
result = round(float(pd.to_numeric(age_rows[1]).mean()), 1)
